title: Add LegalIR actor refinement with frozen conditions and verified release evidence
body:
Adds an actor-refinement decoder that continues trained N11, copies all 42 tensors, and freezes all 36 nonactor tensors, including every learned conditions row. Six actor projection, query and context-gate tensors train for 32 updates.

Training exact IR stays at 154/168. Joint exact IR rises from 51 to 53/72 on the older exposed authored evaluation and from 33 to 34/72 on the newer one. Independent recount finds no complete-IR loss IDs across nine scored scopes and retains all 32 permission cases. The fixed 155/168 training criterion fails, so the checkpoint remains experimental and no default is promoted.

The [immutable Hugging Face release](https://huggingface.co/Publicus/legal-ir-autoencoder/tree/1622817fd804ff5333fce7dc8d04433e4acef2e4/releases/20261014-actor-refinement-v1) contains the checkpoint, all 40 algorithm sources, contract tests, recipes and evaluation evidence: 198 files, 77,331,365 bytes. Forced immutable downloads match every original payload. All 5,448 prior Hub file identities match the baseline at completion. Evidence preserves the interrupted upload, the Hub-added checkpoint LFS rule, the single correction restoring the original attributes file, and the five remaining chunks; the first two chunks were not uploaded again.

A separately verified lossless archive preserves 1,162 historical result files and saves 783,677,871 counted bytes locally. Private runtime snapshots, raw weights, download trees and the large archive are excluded from Git. Incoming main entries, gitlinks and symlinks are preserved.

Validation includes targeted decoder contracts, the actual bounded 32-update run, initial parity across 632 sources, final protected-score bit checks across those same sources, independent result recount, and 35 recovery controls. Hosted CI status is recorded separately; no CI pass is inferred. Exposed authored diagnostics do not qualify statutory semantic accuracy, genuine active 8D/384D/768D latent decoding, broader logic families, isolated numerical reload or `lake build legal`.
